marking_points.text: recession of galaxy (from observer) causes emitted light to have
increase in observed wavelength / decrease in observed frequency
(distant) galaxies show redshift so galaxies are moving apart
galaxies moving apart means universe must be expanding
the speed of recession is proportional to the distance of the galaxies from each other or more distant galaxies are receding faster

Any two points from: • more distant galaxies represent further back in time • a long time ago, all matter in the universe must have been very close together • a long time ago, all matter in the universe must have been moving apart very fast
